Clinic: 4,200 patients, 6 rooms; open 08:00–19:00 weekdays, 09:00–13:00 Saturday. Twelve nurses in three shifts, four admin staff. Accreditation runs to April 2027; renewal needs an infection-control audit.

Attendance averages 180/day, peaking at 310 (January 2025 flu wave). No-shows are 9%, down from 14% after September 2024 reminder texts.

Key incidents: a March 2024 vaccine fridge failure (€2,100 lost) led to a networked alarm plus paper backup; a November 2024 record clash led to record locking.

Rules: no prescription renewal without a consultation in 12 months; vaccine stock counted twice weekly; temperature excursions above 8°C reported same day.

A second ultrasound machine is postponed pending an undone utilisation study. The nursing coordinator post has been vacant since August 2025, covered rotationally by two senior nurses—unsustainable beyond winter.
